info.title: Training Tracker V2.1 implemented API
info.description: Implemented V2.1 API reference for the main runtime and separately marked setup runtime. Request envelopes and binary uploads are documented; dynamic assessment/onboarding content is validated by the referenced domain contracts. Runtime route coverage alone does not prove full source behavior parity or live integration readiness.

post.summary: Advance the reviewed local or hosted installation
post.description: Requires the exact configured origin, setup cookie and CSRF; hosted setup requires HTTPS and local setup requires loopback. Actions: token, requirements, database, administrator, back, install. Token exchange rotates the session. Fresh local setup does not require a console token; hosted setup and legacy upgrades do. Local database input may select server-owned PGlite where available; upgrade requires PostgreSQL. Local administrator input includes separate demoPassword and demoConfirmation. Installation advances one durable stage per request, including 25 resumable local fixture steps; original database/admin fingerprints are pinned. Completion clears the setup cookie.

Returns permission_version for explicit account actions, global_admin_id for the current platform grant, and account_active for current account eligibility. view=admins filters current Global Admin grant holders, including inactive holders; view=all retains existing account eligibility.
